jobs.occupation: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As a Data Engineer for Agentic AI & ML, you will be the architectural bridge between raw data and customer-facing intelligence. You will collaborate deeply with our Data and Platform teams to influence upstream pipelines, ensuring high-fidelity data is ready to power our scheduling and planning software. You will be responsible for extracting, preparing, and optimizing complex datasets to fuel prototyping and production-grade ML solutions. By building custom pipelines for agentic systems, you will enable our users to work faster, better, and better informed, directly enhancing the user experience in Planday through intelligent, autonomous workforce management.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Collaborate with Data and Platform teams to advocate for and influence the design of upstream data pipelines to support AI/ML requirements.

• Extract and transform large-scale datasets from various sources specifically for AI/ML prototyping and model training.

• Design and deploy custom, production-ready data pipelines that power agentic AI workflows and real-time ML inference.

• Implement robust data validation and monitoring for ML-specific features, ensuring data quality and lineage for production models.

**Success looks like

**

• Strong working relationships with the Data and Platform teams that result in AI-ready data infrastructure.

• Reduced time-to-market for AI prototypes through efficient data extraction and preparation workflows.

• High-availability production pipelines supporting live ML models and agentic workflows with minimal data latency.

• Consistent delivery of high-quality, feature-rich datasets that directly improve model performance and agent reliability.

• Proactive identification of data gaps and the successful implementation of new data sources for advanced AI capabilities.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

• At least 3 years of professional experience in data engineering with a focus on supporting ML/AI systems in production.

• Proficiency in SQL and Python for building complex ETL/ELT pipelines and data manipulation for ML.

• Understanding of MLOps principles, including data versioning and feature store management.

• Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and data orchestration tools relevant to LLM and agentic architectures.

• Proven ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines to influence data architecture at the platform level.

• Familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, Databricks, and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship in cerebral interoception at Center for Translational Neuromedicine
jobs.description:
We are offering a PhD fellowship in cerebral interoception commencing 15 February 2027 or after agreement.

  Our group and research
 Center for Translational Neuromedicine focuses on developing new approaches for examining and treating neurological diseases, primarily using the tools of physiology and imaging coupled with cell and gene therapy. Our emphasis is on using these technologies to enable neural and glial cell replacement in the adult brain and spinal cord, as a means of both disease modeling and therapeutic repair.

  Center for Translational Neuromedicine currently has 55 employees and students and is divided into five labs. CTN is characterized by a highly ambitious research environment. The Center is highly interdisciplinary and has many international collaborators. The PhD-student will be part of the Kaag Rasmussen lab, Division of Pain Volume Transmission. Being part of the Kaag Rasmussen lab offers an opportunity to work in an in vivo lab engaged in the neuroscience of pain signalling, focusing on transgenic animal models, behaviour, in vivo imaging and omics technologies. 

  Project description
 In this PhD project we will characterize the functional and molecular characteristics of meningeal sensory neurons. In all the body, different sensory neuron classes project to various targets and are fine-tuned at a functional and molecular level to detect and transmit sensory information from the target organ to the central nervous system. The sensory neurons projecting to dura mater and pia mater have been known to play a role in headache pathology, yet very little is known regarding their functional and molecular properties. This PhD project will dissect out which sensory neuron subtypes project to dura and pia mater, what stimuli they respond to, and define their molecular identity. The aim is to identify what subclasses of meningeal sensory projection neurons are involved in headache experience, and to identify new molecular targets within these sensory neurons that could provide basis for headache therapeutics in the future. To achieve this we will use a combination of in vivo imaging of transgene animals expressing various fluorophores that be used as indicators of neuronal activity and single cell transcriptomics.

  Principal supervisor is Martin Kaag Rasmussen, Center for Translational Neuromedicine, martin.rasmussen@sund.ku.dk.

  Start: 15 February 2027 or after agreement

  Duration: 3 years as a PhD student

  Job description
 Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:

   	
• Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.    	
• Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points. 	
• Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team. 	
• Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project 	
• Teaching and disseminating your knowledge. 	
• Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project   PhD Programme Description
 The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., Neuroscience).

  Qualifications
 If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).

  If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.

  As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.

  Other important criteria are:

   	
• The grade point average achieved 	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Previous publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other professional activities 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in pain and headache as well as basic neuroscience 	
• Language skills   Place of employment
 The place of employment is at the Center for Translational Neuromedicine, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art equipment

  Terms of employment 
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 3 years. The start date is 15 February 2027 or after agreement.

  The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant. The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. 

  Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 31,800 DKK/Roughly 4,250 EUR (August 2026 level) plus pension.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website.

  Application procedure
 Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format: 

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)

  2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

  3. Certified copy of degree diploma(s) relevant to a Danish master’s or bachelor’s degree depending on whether you completed your education in Denmark or abroad (read more under Qualifications). If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science.

  4. Publication list (if possible)

  Application deadline: 17 November 2026, 23.59 CET

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.

  The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.

  Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You find information about the recruitment process here.

  The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Drive Technical Excellence, Lead with Confidence, and Make an Impact as Team Lead for our Hardware Automation team - Gram Equipment A/S
jobs.description:
Are you a technically strong and decisive leader who sets high standards, takes ownership, and drives results?

At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a Team Lead – Hardware, Automation who combines solid electrical engineering expertise with a strong leadership presence and the determination to make things happen.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their technical decisions, comfortable taking responsibility, and motivated by delivering high-quality results. Someone who brings structure, challenges the status quo when needed, and has the courage to set clear expectations and follow through.

In this role, you will lead our Hardware Team within the Automation department, ensuring that we deliver safe, reliable, and production-ready electrical hardware solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you will combine technical expertise with team leadership. Approximately 80% of your time will be dedicated to technical and operational activities, while 20% will focus on leadership, planning, and employee development.

Your role – technical excellence meets strong leadership

As our new Team Lead, you will take responsibility for the daily coordination, technical quality, and performance of a team of six skilled employees in Denmark and one in Turkey.

You will be expected to provide clear direction, establish priorities, and ensure that decisions are translated into action. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in engineering activities, contributing your own technical expertise to complex challenges and important projects.

An important part of your role will be to drive standardization, increase automation of engineering processes, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, helping us create more efficient, scalable, and competitive hardware solutions.

You will work closely with colleagues across Automation, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production, where your ability to communicate clearly, challenge constructively, and stand firm on technical quality and safety will be essential.

You will report to the Global Head of Automation and play an important role in strengthening the performance and capabilities of our Global Engineering & Automation organization.

Your key responsibilities

• Lead with clarity and accountability: Set clear expectations, establish priorities, make decisions, and ensure that commitments are followed through.

• Drive technical execution: Take an active role in electrical design, panel engineering, component selection, BOM development, and technical problem-solving.

• Ensure high technical standards: Review and challenge electrical solutions, maintain compliance with safety requirements, and ensure consistent engineering quality and documentation.

• Drive standardization and engineering automation: Develop and implement standardized electrical designs, components, and documentation practices. Promote automated generation of electrical drawings to reduce manual engineering effort, improve consistency, and increase efficiency.

• Focus on cost optimization: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through smarter design solutions, component standardization, efficient engineering processes, and close collaboration with Procurement and Production, without compromising safety, quality, or reliability.

• Take ownership of planning and delivery: Allocate resources, monitor capacity and progress, address obstacles, and proactively manage delivery risks.

• Make sound technical decisions: Evaluate complex engineering challenges, balance quality, cost, safety, and delivery requirements, and make well-founded decisions, even under pressure.

• Develop and challenge your team: Provide constructive feedback, coach employees, encourage accountability, and support the development of technical competencies.

• Strengthen cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and panel builders to resolve issues and ensure effective project execution.

• Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve standards, processes, tools, and working methods, and take the initiative to turn improvements into measurable results.

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional with a strong technical foundation and a natural ability to take the lead.

You enjoy responsibility, have a structured and analytical approach, and are comfortable making decisions and standing behind them.

Ideally, you bring:

• A relevant technical or engineering background within electrical engineering, automation, or a related field.

• Solid experience with electrical design and panel engineering for industrial machinery.

• Strong knowledge of electrical safety, technical standards, and regulatory requirements, including CE and DS/EN/IEC 60204-1.

• Experience with electrical components, BOM structures, technical documentation, and engineering standards.

• A strong understanding of standardization and an interest in automated engineering processes, including automated generation of electrical drawings.

• A commercial mindset with the ability to identify cost optimization opportunities while maintaining technical quality and compliance.

• The ability to analyze complex technical challenges and make clear, well-founded decisions.

• Experience coordinating technical work, managing priorities, and ensuring delivery against commitments.

• Previous experience in technical leadership, team coordination, or people management, or demonstrated leadership potential combined with a strong desire to take responsibility.

Your personality makes the difference

For this position, your personal drive and leadership approach are just as important as your technical qualifications.

We are looking for someone who brings a strong personality, clear direction, and high professional standards to the team.

You are likely to recognize yourself in the following:

• Decisive and confident: You are comfortable taking the lead, making decisions, and addressing challenges directly rather than waiting for others to act.

• Analytical and detail-oriented: You approach technical challenges systematically, question assumptions, and base your decisions on facts and sound engineering judgment.

• Results-driven and accountable: You set ambitious but realistic expectations, take ownership, and follow through to ensure that objectives are achieved.

• Structured and quality-conscious: You value precision, consistency, and well-defined processes and are unwilling to compromise on safety or critical quality requirements.

jobs.description:
If you are excited by doing reactive extrusion, online monitoring and materials characterization for renewable polymer systems such as PHAs, this could be the PhD project for you.

Responsibilities and qualifications
The objective of this PhD project is to develop next-generation polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) compounds through advanced polymer processing, formulation, and reactive extrusion. The project will focus on improving processability and performance while establishing relationships between formulation, processing history, polymer structure, and final material properties. 

As a PhD student, you will prepare and process new PHA formulations using extrusion-based methods, investigate reactive processing and novel additive concepts, and evaluate compounds for injection moulding, extrusion, and blow moulding. You will combine offline polymer characterization with online and in-line analytical methods to monitor changes during processing and support adaptive control of composition and process conditions. 

We are therefore looking for candidates with: 

• Practical experience in polymer processing, preferably extrusion or reactive extrusion, obtained through MSc studies or equivalent research activities. 
• A strong interest in biopolymers (natural polymers), polymer formulation, compounding, and structure-property-processing relationships. 
• Hands-on experience with polymer characterization, particularly FTIR, rheology, DSC, TGA, and NMR. 
• Experience with Raman spectroscopy, online analysis, or process monitoring, which will be considered an advantage. 
• Experience with injection moulding, film or profile extrusion, or blow moulding, which will be considered an advantage. 
• The ability to plan experimental work independently and collaborate effectively across polymer chemistry, processing, and analytical disciplines. 
• An interest in teaching and supervising student projects as part of the PhD programme. 
The project is expected to generate new knowledge on the processing and stabilization of PHA-based materials and to deliver high-performance compounds designed for safe handling, demanding processing routes, and environmentally benign end-of-life scenarios. 

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

jobs.occupation: Embedded Software & Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.

The role
You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).

What you will do

• Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
• Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
• Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
• Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
• Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
• Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
• Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
• Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
• Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months

• You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
• You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
• You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
• You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
• If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
• You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.

• At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
• Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
• Strong C++ programming skills.
• Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
• Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
• Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
• Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
• Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
• Professional fluency in English.
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.

• You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
• You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
• You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
• You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
• You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO
A hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team, similar to a pair-programming exercise. The focus is on understanding your technical approach, problem-solving and how you collaborate.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.

4. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto’s technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

jobs.occupation: Banquet Supervisor
jobs.description:
D’ANGLETERRE IS LOOKING FOR A SUPERVISOR FOR OUR BANQUET TEAM

Are you a natural leader who knows how to bring people together, communicate clearly and create memorable guest experiences?

At d’Angleterre, we are looking for a Banquet Supervisor with strong leadership and communication skills who enjoys taking responsibility and leading from the front. You know how to create structure in a busy environment, motivate your team and collaborate effortlessly across departments, always with the guest experience at the centre.

If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and thrive in an environment where attention to detail, teamwork and personal service matter, we would love to hear from you.

WE OFFER

You will become part of an international and ambitious environment where no two days are the same. Together with a dedicated team, you will create personal, stylish and elegant experiences for everything from intimate meetings to larger events and celebrations.

Through our internal d’Anglecademy, you will also have access to training and development opportunities designed to support your professional and personal growth.

ABOUT THE JOB

As our Banquet Supervisor, you will play a key role in the daily operation of the Banquet department. You will lead and support a team of dedicated waiters and ensure that meetings, events and celebrations are executed to the high standards our guests expect from d’Angleterre.

A central part of your role will be communication and coordination. You will work closely with colleagues across the hotel, communicate directly with meeting and event guests, and ensure that everyone involved has the information they need.

You will be expected to take ownership, remain calm when plans change and set the standard through your own presence and behavior.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for someone who is confident in taking the lead while still being approachable and supportive.

You are a strong communicator who can give clear direction, listen to your team and build positive working relationships across different departments. You understand that great leadership is not only about managing the operation, but also about creating trust, motivating others and bringing out the best in your team.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from a similar role within hotels, restaurants, events or luxury hospitality

• Have strong leadership skills and enjoy taking responsibility

• Are an excellent communicator who can communicate confidently with guests, colleagues and management

• Know how to motivate, guide and support a team during both busy and quieter moments

• Are structured, proactive and attentive to detail

• Stay calm and solution-oriented when priorities change

• Lead by example and take pride in creating exceptional guest experiences

• Enjoy working closely with other departments and understand the importance of teamwork

• Are flexible and comfortable working evenings, weekends and varying shifts

Above all, we are looking for someone with presence, energy and a genuine interest in people. Someone who can combine operational excellence with warm leadership and who wants to contribute to both the guest experience and the development of the team.

ABOUT D’ANGLETERRE

At d’Angleterre, we believe that people are at the heart of true luxury hospitality. Our history, surroundings and traditions are important, but it is our colleagues who bring the experience to life every day.

That is why we look not only for experience and professional skills, but for people with the right attitude: individuals who are passionate, pragmatic, flexible and genuinely committed to delivering personal five-star service.
